scope: Source-level service follow-up for exact national US House/Senate and 24 named chambers in Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii and Idaho. State umbrella rows excluded. These 26 identity rows are not 26 independent legislatures, feeds or new catalogue channels.
method: Current official chamber pages and chamber-specific provider designations, normal bounded public HTTP reads, normal Chromium rendering for JavaScript applications and web-reader/indexed official documents. Failed/blocked routes are retained without bypass; indexed-only evidence is lower-depth. No raw HTML or media retained, no outreach, no decoded video/audio, no permission inferred from visibility. Historical catalogue umbrella evidence is not inherited into named chambers.
observational_limits: Review date is Saturday October24,2026 and many chambers are in recess; no live event today is not evidence of service failure.
Provider self-labels and current archive rows establish designation/documentary leads, not decoded playback, audible tracks, current captions, completeness or permanent endpoints.
All seven use types remain source-specific; conditional restrictions do not automatically grant other uses, and no licence found does not imply prohibition.
Machine-readable legislative bill feeds, order papers and programme guides are different products; no uninspected feed link is counted as a validated guide.
No blanket legal conclusion about statutory exceptions, government-work copyright, or the applicability of each notice is made.
